Monthly payment on a fixed rate loan

Source: R/mortgage_payment.R
mortgage_payment.Rd

The standard amortization formula with monthly compounding. At a 0% rate this is principal / (years * 12). From the Major purchases chapter.

Usage

mortgage_payment(principal, annual_rate, years)

Arguments

principal

Loan amount.

annual_rate

Yearly interest rate, as a decimal.

years

Loan term in years. Must be greater than 0.

Value

A numeric vector of monthly payments.

See also

Other major purchases: first_payment_split(), rent_buy_threshold()

Examples

# $480,000 loan at 6% over 30 years
mortgage_payment(principal = 480000, annual_rate = 0.06, years = 30)
#> [1] 2877.843
